quests.title: Wanmin Fresh

dialogue.t: Sure, go do what you have to. I'll get someone else...
Please be careful while you deliver the food, and do not touch anything strange, or use your wind glider.
Otherwise, I fear that the Mora Meat might stop having any meat in it altogether...

dialogue.section: Deliver the food to Curious Zi'rui

dialogue.t: Why isn't the food here yet? It's been ages...

dialogue.sit: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogue.t: That's right. A kid named Zi'rui ordered Mora Meat from us.
He wanted us to deliver it to a place near Luhua Pool.
Since I have my hands full manning the restaurant at the moment, could you help me with that delivery?
Oh, finally! Thank you so much.
I've still got some distance to go after this.
*sigh* There aren't a ton of interesting rocks here, either...

quests.description: Wanmin Restaurant has taken a custom order that now awaits delivery...
